PaletteLayer.Override
A change to a vanilla item, registered with PaletteLayer.Builder.overrideItem(String, Consumer).
Paletter
Entry point: vanilla Bedrock data for every supported version, and the palettes compiled from it.
Paletter.Builder
Configures the global policy of a Paletter: everything that is the same for every palette it compiles.
PaletteReport
Everything noteworthy that happened while compiling a palette: content left out for a version, anchors that matched nothing, fallbacks that were used.
PaletteReport.Entry
One thing that happened while compiling.
PaletteReport.Level
How serious an PaletteReport.Entry is.
